typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

spec.description:
The {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationSpec} that was used to
generate the datasets detailed in this {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}.

start.description:
The start timestamp of the datasets created as part of
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

end.description:
The end timestamp of the datasets created as part of
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

interval.description:
The interval used in all the steps of the dataset preparation,
specified in {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationSpec#interval}.

featurePreparation.description:
This field will report the status of the feature creation step of the
overall {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

featureDatasets.description: The dataset corresponding to the features that will be input to the {@link MlModel}.

trainFeatureTimeRanges.description: The time range used to extract training data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

valFeatureTimeRanges.description: The time range used to extract validation data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

maskPreparation.description:
This field will report the status of the masks creation step of the
overall {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

maskDatasets.description:
The dataset corresponding to the masks that will be input to the {@link MlModel}.

The key of the map is a string descriptor for the mask feature set. One example is 'mask_AdHocTraining'.

trainMaskTimeRanges.description: The mask time range used to extract training data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

valMaskTimeRanges.description: The mask time range used to extract validation data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

alertContextPreparation.description:
This field will report the status of the alertContext creation step of the
overall {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

alertContextDatasets.description: The dataset corresponding to the alertContext that will be input to the {@link MlModel}.

targetPreparation.description:
This field will report the status of the target creation step of the
overall {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets},
if {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationSpec#evaluateTarget} is `true`.

targetDatasets.description: The dataset corresponding to the targets that will be input to the {@link MlModel}.

trainTargetTimeRanges.description: The target time range used to extract training data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

valTargetTimeRanges.description: The target time range used to extract validation data from {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}.

trainValSplit.description:
This field will report the status of the dataset splitting step of the
overall {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.

xFeatures.description:
Use this in `x` argument of {@link ReliabilityMlModel#createReliabilityModel}.
This field represents the feature sets that are used as input variables (`x`) for training the machine learning model.

features.description:
The list of features that will be used in training an {@link MlModel}.
The list, and the order of feature names in this field will be the same
as if one were to fetch the feature names by keying into `features` in
{@link xFeatures}.

numFeatures.description:
A convenience field that represents the length of the {@link features}
array, giving the total number of features to be used in the model.

yFeatures.description:
Use this in `y` argument of {@link ReliabilityMlModel#createReliabilityModel}.
This field represents the target feature sets (`y`) for training the machine learning model.

status.description:
Overall status of {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}.
This indicates whether the dataset preparation process is in progress, complete, or has failed.

includeSensors.description:
The sensors included in the dataset preparation run.
This is a list of sensors that contributed to the dataset used for training.

excludeSensors.description:
The sensors excluded from the dataset preparation run.
This is a list of sensors that were not considered in the dataset used for training.

trainSnapshots.description:
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot} ids for the training period associated with this run,
for each {@link Feature.Set} in {@link #xFeatures} and {@link #yFeatures}.

valSnapshots.description:
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot} ids for the validation period associated with this run,
for each {@link Feature.Set} in {@link #xFeatures} and {@link #yFeatures}.

title:
Common mixin type for {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} and
{@link ReliabilityMlPopulationDatasetPreparationRun}. This entity is not meant to be upserted directly. It exists
to produce a unified table for {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} and
{@link ReliabilityMlPopulationDatasetPreparationRun}. {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} and
{@link ReliabilityMlPopulationDatasetPreparationRun} are the entity types that should be upserted.
name: ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRunCommon
